grid.land_source: Natural Earth 1:10m land v5.1.1 (ne_10m_land.zip sha256 e547d749445eaa0964aba76738090ec88f5e63c4585122170f98c67a7ea922dc), clipped per 1deg cell in lon/lat, area in EPSG:6933

unit.label: Aqua MODIS detections per 1,000 km² of land per year (2003–2011 mean)
unit.definition: n_total / n_years / land_km2 x 1000; counts are satellite detections, not fires

notes: Single sensor (Aqua MODIS), native counts; no cross-sensor harmonization involved.
value 0 means no Aqua detections were reported in the period; it is not proof of no fire.
FIRMS country archives drop detections not assigned to a country; coastal cells may be undercounted.
Cells with < 500 km2 land are omitted; 9507 detections fell in omitted cells and are excluded from cells but included in latitude bands.
Latitude-band monthly share is a seasonality summary of detections, not a forecast.
Input global_1deg_monthly.parquet sha256 30170d002278d72a414934874f56312972746448fd79807761518820450d5937; standard-processing rows only.
filter type0_nh = type 0 (presumed vegetation) and MODIS confidence >= 30 (prereg type0_conf30).
